header.name: plexus
header.tagline: Point it at your tools and it computes how they plug together.

flows.kicker: one tool set, one runnable order
flows.title: How a pile of tools becomes a plan you can check later
flows.footnote: Verify re-derives the plan from the manifests. The saved body is never trusted.
flows.alt: Eight stages from manifest to verify: manifest, discover, capability, wiring, goal, plan, receipt, verify. Each tool ships a small manifest naming what it emits and what it consumes. Discovery reads every manifest and hashes its canonical content. A capability is a typed name, and an edge exists wherever one tool emits a name another consumes. Naming a goal produces a dependency order with any feedback loops reported rather than forced flat. The receipt binds the plan to the content hash of every manifest behind it plus a hash over the plan body. Verify re-derives the plan from the live mesh and compares receipts, so a tampered body and a manifest that changed both fail. Two outcomes: still holds, and drifted.

stages.title: Manifest
stages.note: Each tool ships one: what it emits, what it needs.

stages.title: Discover
stages.note: Every manifest read, and its content hashed.

stages.title: Capability
stages.note: A typed name, on both sides of an edge.

stages.title: Wiring
stages.note: An edge wherever a name matches across tools.

stages.title: Goal
stages.note: The tool you want fed, named on the command line.

stages.title: Plan
stages.note: An order over the graph, with cycles reported.

stages.title: Receipt
stages.note: The plan hash, and every manifest hash behind it.

stages.title: Verify
stages.note: Re-derive from the mesh, then compare receipts.

returns.label: VERIFY NEVER TRUSTS THE SAVED PLAN BODY

outcomes.label: STILL HOLDS
outcomes.note: the same manifests re-derive the same plan

outcomes.label: DRIFTED
outcomes.note: a manifest moved under the saved plan

flows.kicker: one mesh, and what it will not pretend
flows.title: How the parts that do not connect get named instead of hidden
flows.footnote: Every edge is declared by its producer. Nothing here imports or runs the source it cites.
flows.alt: Eight stages of the honesty surface: tool set, emits, consumes, match, leftover, loop, collision, report. Only the manifests present are considered. A capability name appearing on both an emit and a consume side becomes an edge. Every name that matched on only one side is a leftover: an unmet input that nothing in the set produces, or an output nobody downstream takes. A cycle is surfaced as a feedback loop rather than forced into a false linear order, and an organ id claimed by two manifests is named as a collision rather than resolved last writer wins. Three outcomes: wired, colliding, and unmet.

stages.title: Tool set
stages.note: The manifests present, and nothing else.

stages.title: Emits
stages.note: What each one declares that it produces.

stages.title: Consumes
stages.note: What each one declares that it needs.

stages.title: Match
stages.note: A name on both sides becomes one edge.

stages.title: Leftover
stages.note: Every name that matched on one side only.

stages.title: Loop
stages.note: An edge set that returns where it started.

stages.title: Collision
stages.note: One organ id claimed by two manifests.

stages.title: Report
stages.note: Named in the output, never quietly resolved.

returns.label: EACH LEFTOVER IS NAMED, ONE BY ONE

outcomes.label: WIRED
outcomes.note: every input has a producer in the set

outcomes.label: COLLIDING
outcomes.note: two manifests claim the same organ id

outcomes.label: UNMET
outcomes.note: an input nothing in the set emits
